intro: Ten minutes before curtain, every part in the pit was swapped for something else, and the conductor refuses to go on until the real score is found. The music librarian is going through the crates backstage, and in every one she finds a single sheet that does not belong: a stowaway folded into the wrong pocket. She lays each one on the table, and as she sorts them she notices that each stowaway carries the same small mark, like a note passed from player to player. She has begun writing the marks in a column down the side of her work list, though she cannot say what they add up to. The hall is full of the smell of rosin and the low hum of the audience, and the conductor waits.
echo: Four movements, a hundred players, and Beethoven wrote nine of them.
